items.title: 面向大语言模型审阅者的对抗性代码注释数据集
items.title_orig: Adversarial code comments dataset for LLM reviewers
items.summary: Sunny Chokshi。2026 年 11 月 4 日。我想知道，对于同一段代码，一条注释是否会改变 LLM 代码审核者的评价。因此，我构建了一个小型对抗性代码注释数据集，名为 CommentInject。易受攻击的函数保持不变。只添加了一条注释，该注释声称代码是
items.summary_orig: Sunny Chokshi. November 4, 2026. I wanted to know whether a comment can change what an LLM code reviewer says about the same code. So I built a small adversarial code comments dataset, CommentInject. The vulnerable function stays identical. Only a comment is added, and the comment claims the code is safe.

items.summary_orig: Most teams that let an AI agent issue refunds start with a simple guardrail: a per-action limit. Each refund the agent issues has to stay under some amount, and anything bigger goes to a person. That limit is useful, but it answers the wrong question. It tells you how much a single refund can be. It doesn't tell you how much a single order can lose.

items.summary_orig: 다 끝나면 Codex CLI한테 "Launch plan 프로젝트, 어제부터 뭐 바뀌었어?"라고 물었을 때 노트랑 채널을 전부 다시 읽지 않고 답이 나온다. Codex는 먼저 osFoundry 에 오너가 허용한 리소스를 묻고( list_granted_resources ), 프로젝트 안에 뭐가 있는지 찾고( list_project_resources ), 리소스마다 마지막으로 본 시퀀스 번호 이후의 이벤트만 가져온다( poll_resource_events ). 번호는 리포지토리 안 작은 파일에 남겨 두니까 다음 Codex 세션은 지난번에 멈춘 데서 이어 간다. 호출은 전부 osFoundry 쪽 연결의 Recent activity에 남는다.

items.title: 3D 模型转换格式时会丢失哪些数据
items.title_orig: What gets lost when you convert a 3D model between formats
items.summary: 改扩展名不等于转换：STL 只存三角形，OBJ 用 MTL 存材质，GLB/glTF 可保存含 PBR 材质和动画的完整场景。
items.summary_orig: Changing a 3D file's extension does not convert it. Each format carries different data: STL stores triangles only: no materials, textures or units. OBJ keeps materials in a separate MTL file and textures as image files. GLB / glTF can hold a whole scene with PBR materials and animation.

items.title: 为什么衰老的恒星的光度突然下降
items.title_orig: Why Aging Stars Suffer A Sudden Luminosity Dip
items.summary: 当像太阳这样的低质量恒星老化时，它们会离开主序并跟随红巨星分支。当它们上升到这个分支时，它们的亮度稳步增加。但路径中存在一种称为 RGB 亮度凹凸的小问题，它们的亮度会突然下降。
items.summary_orig: When low-mass stars like our Sun age, they leave the main sequence and follow the Red Giant Branch. As they ascend this branch, their luminosity steadily increases. But there's a sort of hiccup in the path called the RGB luminosity bump, where their luminosity suddenly dips.

items.title: 让 AI 视频也记住往事
显示 HN：Nino v4 – .NET SortedList 的 SIMD 反序列化
items.title_orig: Show HN: Nino v4 – SIMD deserialization for .NET SortedList
items.summary: 我维护 Nino，一个用于 C# 的源代码生成的二进制序列化器。我一直致力于的一项优化是反序列化为现有的 .NET SortedList。有线格式交错键和值，而 SortedList 将它们存储在单独的数组中。如果目的地已经有房间，我们可以检查一下吗？
items.summary_orig: I maintain Nino, a source-generated binary serializer for C#. One optimization I’ve been working on is deserializing into an existing .NET SortedList. The wire format interleaves keys and values, while SortedList stores them in separate arrays. If the destination already has room, can we check the order and fill both arrays in one pass?
